content.comment_body: Hello everyone. Is it possible to use a digital value in [product_name] as a momentary push button? Thanks for your help!

Currently, [product_name] does not offer this function, but it may be available in a future update. As an alternative, you can implement this feature through the [product_name] program itself. Add a network input in your program to act as the push button, along with a corresponding network output using the same address. Link the network output to a LOW block. When you click the digital value in the extended web server, the network input status turns HIGH. [product_name] then processes your logic and resets the network input using the LOW block, so the input stays HIGH for only one cycle. Please see the attached example.
Thank you for your quick response and solution, [user_name].

analysis.insight_summary: Users noted that while it's not currently possible to use a digital value as a momentary push button within [product_name] directly, a workaround using programming is available. The discussion highlights a missing feature in the current version, with users hoping it will be added in future updates to improve ease of use.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want the ability to use a digital value as a momentary push button directly in [product_name] without needing programming workarounds.
